changelog:
✨ New Features
• Theme: Add "Glow Morphe" experimental splash screen type
• Minimal miniplayer: Swipe the bar up to move it to the top of the screen instead of expanding the player
• Hide layout components: Add "Hide 'Unavailable videos are hidden' banner" setting

🌟 Mod Features
• All Morphe patches for YouTube
• Google and Yandex voice-over translation (VoT)
• Video downloader with Save to device
• Customizable preset settings for a Premium-like experience
• Extra clone variant with Dynamic Island on supported devices
• In-app update check for new builds

🐛 Bug Fixes
• Video quality: Extend the background resume fix of regular videos to Shorts
• Feed thumbnail badges are shown on the page header of a channel that is live
• Feed card layout: Movies converted to cards are not hidden when "Hide movies section" is enabled
• Hide layout components: "Visit the community" entry point is not hidden in the comments of a video opened from a playlist
• Ambient mode: Ambient mode is replaced by a black background with the new watch page experiment
• Feed view count: View count badge of a card that enters from the bottom loads only when its title row is shown
• Video quality: Regular video returns to the default quality when it resumes from the background
• Video quality: Buffered video is cleared with the placeholder playback times of live streams after selecting a quality
• Video quality: Short loop restarts with the previous quality when the quality is selected in its first segment
• Fix TalkBack not reading captions
• Video quality: Quality selected for a regular video is lost when the video reloads
• Video quality: Short plays the previous quality segments again when it loops
• Prevent TalkBack crashes caused by Litho hover recursion
• Ambient mode: Bypass Ambient mode restrictions does not work with 21.43
• Watch history search bar from getting hidden when selected
• Feed thumbnail badges disappear while scrolling, are missing on cards with replaced titles and are shown on live videos
• Video quality: Video restarts or plays faster after selecting a quality

🔧 Improvements
• Theme: Patches now use Morphe Patcher 2.0.0
